text: Official CLI scaffolds a new Docusaurus site (create-docusaurus)
Write docs and blog posts in MDX; Docusaurus compiles them to static HTML
quote: Simply write docs and blog posts with MDX, and Docusaurus builds them into static HTML files ready to be served.

text: MDX lets you embed JSX/React components directly inside Markdown files
quote: Docusaurus has built-in support for MDX, which allows you to write JSX within your Markdown files and render them as React components.

text: Site layout can be extended/customized with your own React components via a pluggable architecture
quote: Extend and customize your project's layout by writing React components. Leverage the pluggable architecture, and design your own site while reusing the same data created by Docusaurus plugins.

text: First-class built-in support for Algolia DocSearch for site search
quote: Docusaurus provides first-class support for Algolia DocSearch.

text: Versioning CLI creates a new documentation version snapshot from current docs
quote: You can use the versioning CLI to create a new documentation version based on the latest content in the docs directory.

text: Built-in i18n support makes translating the whole site straightforward
quote: Localization comes out-of-the-box. Use git, Crowdin, or any other translation manager to translate your docs and deploy them individually.

text: Site features (docs, blog, pages) are each provided by separate installable npm plugins
quote: All features are delegated to individual plugins: the docs feature provided by the docs plugin; the blog feature provided by the blog plugin; or individual pages provided by the pages plugin.

text: Custom global CSS can be added via a custom.css file with the classic theme
quote: you can create your own CSS files (e.g. /src/css/custom.css) and import them globally by passing them as an option of the classic theme.

text: Swizzling lets you swap out a built-in theme component for your own implementation
quote: swizzling permits to swap a theme component with your own implementation

text: Local development server builds and serves a live preview of the site via Webpack Dev Server
quote: Builds and serves a preview of your site locally with Webpack Dev Server.

text: Blog plugin enables deploying a full-featured blog quickly
quote: The blog feature enables you to deploy a full-featured blog in no time.

text: `npm run build` compiles the site into static files ready for hosting
quote: To build the static files of your website for production, run: npm run build

text: Third-party or custom-defined components can be imported and used within MDX pages
quote: You can also import your own components defined in other files or third-party components installed via npm.

text: Markdown parser can opt in to strict CommonMark format via site config
quote: It is possible to **opt-in for CommonMark** using the [`siteConfig.markdown.format`](/docs/api/docusaurus-config#markdown) setting
